data.gender_notes: Barot is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Marathi word ‘baroda’, meaning ‘fort on a mountain’. This name is associated with strength, courage, and protection, evoking images of ancient hill forts and the warriors who defended them. The name Barot carries the meaning “Mountain fort” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Marathi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Barot usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain fort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner strength and resilience.
data.etymology: Barot belongs to the Marathi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain fort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Barot total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
